U64.description: u64, ondalık string (JS number hassasiyetini aşmamak için)

creator.description: Original registrant; part of the PDA seeds, never changes.

wallet.description: Agent wallet: signs escrow `accept_job` / `submit_work` / `list_claim` and is the default payee.

agentCardHash.description: SHA-256 of the agent card JSON served at `agent_card_uri`.

AgentReputation.description: seeds = ["reputation", agent_record] — bound to the registry agent, not to a wallet (BC-26).

ClaimStatus.description: `cancel_claim` closes the listing, so there is no Cancelled state.

rentPayer.description: Paid the listing rent; receives it back on `cancel_claim`.

DisputeInfo.description: Inline dispute state; `raised_at == 0` means no dispute. One dispute per job.

deadline.description: `raised_at + dispute_timeout_secs`; votes before it, `lapse_dispute` at or after it.

lapsed.description: Set by `lapse_dispute`; the institution cannot raise a second dispute, the agent may escalate again after `proof_timeout_secs`.

arbitratorSetVersion.description: `config.arbitrator_set_version` the tally is counted against; a newer set restarts the tally.

keeperFeeBps.description: Share of the escrowed amount paid to the `finalize_payment` caller (BC-23).

travelRuleThreshold.description: Jobs at or above this amount need a Travel Rule commitment before `fund_job`; 0 = disabled.

settlementMint.description: The only mint jobs can use (USDC). Policy ceilings and the daily counter are in its units.

registryProgram.description: Owner of `AgentRecord` / `ScreeningRecord` accounts read by escrow.

policyProgram.description: Owner of `Institution` / `Policy` accounts read by escrow.

verifierProgram.description: Owner of `ReleaseProof`; target of the `record_release` CPI.

arbitratorSetVersion.description: Bumped on every `update_arbitrators`; disputes snapshot it.

FiatJobCreated.description: A fiat job was opened by `create_fiat_job` (ADR 0024): no vault, always proof-gated.

ownerKey.description: The key the institution was created with; part of the PDA seeds, never changes.

multisigVault.description: Squads vault PDA that is the sole authority once set (derived from `multisig` + vault index).

Job.description: seeds = ["job", institution, spec_hash]; vault = ["escrow_token", job], bond vault = ["bond", job] (token authority of both = job).

institution.description: Institution wallet or Squads vault that created/funds the job; refund target.

agentRecord.description: square_registry `AgentRecord` the job is bound to; reputation is written against it.

agentWallet.description: `AgentRecord.wallet` at creation (or at the last `sync_agent_wallet`); signs accept/submit/list and is the payee unless the receivable was sold.

rentPayer.description: Paid the rent of the job and its vaults; receives it back when they close.

specHash.description: SHA-256 of the off-chain job spec JSON (A2A task mapping, BE side).

challengeEnd.description: Set in `submit_work`; finalize allowed after it.

travelRuleCommitment.description: Salted Travel Rule commitment bound before funding (ADR 0015); all zeros = none.

policyCommitment.description: Policy snapshot taken at `create_job` (zeros when `policy` is None). The release proof is checked against it, so later policy updates or deactivation cannot change this job's rules.

bondBump.description: Set by `raise_dispute`; 0 while no bond vault exists.

rail.description: How the job is paid (ADR 0024). Appended last: accounts created before the field read their zero padding as `Escrow`.

MppPaymentVerified.description: A Stripe (MPP) payment bound to a fiat job by `verify_mpp_payment_proof` (ADR 0024).

dailySpent.description: Released amount in the current UTC day (settlement-mint atomic units); circuit public input.

dayStartUnix.description: UTC midnight that starts the current window.

commitment.description: Salted Poseidon commitment of the policy (the policy itself stays off chain).

dailyCeiling.description: Public daily spending ceiling in settlement-mint atomic units (USDC: 6 decimals).

buyerRoot.description: Root of the salted approved-buyer Merkle tree; all zeros = unrestricted.

screeningTtlSecs.description: Lifetime of a screening record; `expires_at = screened_at + screening_ttl_secs`.

institution.description: square_policy `Institution` PDA (key of the `OperatorState` it advances).

payee.description: Address the proof is bound to: the agent wallet, or the claim buyer if the receivable was sold.

netAmount.description: Amount the payee receives; escrow compares it with its own net at release.

dailySpentBefore.description: `OperatorState.daily_spent` the proof was built against; a different value at release = stale.

refusalCode.description: Policy rule that refused the release (0 when compliant). Codes defined with the circuit (BC-19).

sourceHash.description: Hash of the screening evidence (provider response / list version).

TravelRuleCommitted.description: A Travel Rule commitment was bound to an Open job (BC-34).

ValidationRecord.description: seeds = ["validation", job] — gate outcome of a settled job (BC-26); written once per job.

escrowProgram.description: Owner of `Job` / `ClaimListing`; its ["escrow_authority"] PDA may call `record_release`.

policyProgram.description: Owner of `Institution` / `Policy` accounts read by the verifier.

mppAuthority.description: Ed25519 key whose attestations bind Stripe (MPP) payments to fiat jobs; rotated by the admin with `update_mpp_authority` (ADR 0024).

vkVersion.description: Version of the embedded verifying key (bumped after the phase-2 ceremony, BC-38).

DeregisterAgentCall.description: Terminal: sets `Deregistered`. The record is kept (not closed) so the same (creator, agent_id) can never be re-registered and inherit the agent's reputation or did:aip.

InitRegistryConfigCall.description: Creates the singleton registry config. Only the program upgrade authority (Squads vault) can call it (checked through `program_data`), so the config cannot be front-run.

RecordScreeningCall.description: Flow step 3: the screener service (BE-16) records a sanctions screening result for a wallet. Escrow reads it on `fund_job` (institution and agent), `buy_claim` (buyer) and release (payee).

RegisterAgentCall.description: Flow step 2: an agent registers; it resolves as did:aip (Solana profile, BC-14). `agent_id` is an immutable slug, unique per creator and never reusable (see `deregister_agent`).

SetAgentStatusCall.description: Pauses (`Inactive`) or resumes (`Active`) the agent. Escrow rejects `create_job` and `accept_job` for a non-active agent; jobs already accepted can still be delivered and settled. `Deregistered` is not accepted here.

TransferAgentOwnershipCall.description: Transfers ownership and resets `wallet` to the new owner (did:aip Solana profile §4.2). The PDA is derived from the immutable `creator`, so the address stays stable.

UpdateAgentCall.description: Updates the agent card pointer/hash and the agent wallet. Owner only. Jobs keep the wallet they were created with until the owner calls escrow `sync_agent_wallet`.

UpdateRegistryConfigCall.description: Rotates the screener authority and the screening record lifetime.

DeactivatePolicyCall.description: Deactivates a policy: no new jobs can reference it. Existing jobs settle against their snapshot.

InitInstitutionCall.description: Creates the institution account for `authority` (which becomes `owner_key`).

SetBuyerRootCall.description: Flow step 5 (institution side): publishes the root of the salted approved-buyer list. Leaf = sha256(buyer_pubkey || leaf_salt); escrow `buy_claim` checks a Merkle proof against the current root. An all-zero root means "no buyer restriction".

SetInstitutionMultisigCall.description: Binds (or, signed by the current vault, rebinds) a Squads v4 multisig. Afterwards only its vault PDA (`vault_index`) may sign as authority.

SetPolicyCall.description: Flow step 1: commits a spending policy. Only the salted Poseidon commitment and the public daily ceiling (settlement-mint atomic units) are stored.

UpdatePolicyCall.description: Replaces the commitment and/or daily ceiling and increments `version`. Existing jobs keep the snapshot taken at `create_job`.

InitVerifierConfigCall.description: Creates the singleton verifier config. Only the program upgrade authority (Squads vault) can call it. `escrow_program` / `policy_program` pin the owners checked on account-read.

RecordReleaseCall.description: CPI-only (escrow, signed by its `escrow_authority` PDA): marks the release proof consumed and advances `OperatorState.daily_spent` (UTC-day rollover) by the released net amount.

SetComplianceProofCall.description: Flow step 7: verifies a Groth16 proof (alt_bn128) of the release circuit (13 public signals, docs/design/release-circuit.md §2). The program builds ten of the signals itself from the accounts: the job's policy snapshot (`Job.policy_commitment`, `Job.policy_daily_ceiling`), the payee (claim buyer if the receivable was sold, else `Job.agent_wallet`), the mint, the institution's daily counter (`OperatorState`, UTC day rollover applied), the job address and a zero `stripe_receipt_hash`. The caller supplies `refusal_code`, `net_amount` and `proof_timestamp`, which must be within the clock tolerance. Writes `ReleaseProof` with a verdict; a refusing proof records `Refused` + reason code. Can be re-bound until escrow consumes it. Arguments: `refusal_code` is public signal 0, the bit mask of broken rules (0 when compliant, release-circuit.md §3); `net_amount` is public signal 5, the amount the payee receives; `proof_timestamp` is public signal 9, the instant the proof evaluates the policy at (Unix seconds).

UpdateMppAuthorityCall.description: The config admin (Squads vault) rotates the MPP attestation key without a program upgrade. A zero key disables the fiat rail: no attestation can verify.

VerifyMppPaymentProofCall.description: Fiat rail (ADR 0024): binds a Stripe (MPP) payment to a delivered fiat job. The instruction right before it must be the Ed25519 precompile verifying `config.mpp_authority`'s signature on `"square/mpp-attestation/v1" || job || stripe_receipt_hash || amount (u64 LE)`, `amount` being the job amount. The Groth16 proof is checked against the same 13 signals as `set_compliance_proof` with `refusal_code` 0, `net_amount` = job amount, payee = agent wallet and the non-zero `stripe_receipt_hash` (public signal 12). Writes a `Compliant` `ReleaseProof` that `finalize_fiat_payment` consumes. Arguments: `stripe_receipt_hash` is the Poseidon commitment of the Stripe receipt; `proof_timestamp` is public signal 9 (Unix seconds).

AcceptJobCall.description: The job's agent wallet accepts a funded job (a fiat job while Open); the agent record must be Active. `spec_hash` guards against a swapped spec.

BuyClaimCall.description: A screened buyer on the institution's approved list buys the receivable. `price` must equal the listing price (front-running guard). Leaf = sha256(buyer || leaf_salt), checked against the current `policy.buyer_root`; jobs without a policy or with an all-zero root are unrestricted.

CancelClaimCall.description: The seller withdraws an unsold listing; the account is closed and its rent returned.

CancelFiatJobCall.description: Fiat rail (ADR 0024): the institution cancels an Open job, or an Accepted job after `deadline`. There is no vault and nothing to refund.

CancelJobCall.description: The institution cancels an Open / Funded job, or an Accepted job after `deadline`; the vault balance is refunded and the vault closed (rent to `job.rent_payer`).

CommitTravelRuleCall.description: Binds a salted Travel Rule commitment to an Open job (no PII on chain, ADR 0015). It can be replaced until `fund_job`, which requires it when `amount >= params.travel_rule_threshold` (threshold 0 = disabled).

CreateFiatJobCall.description: Fiat rail (ADR 0024): the institution opens a job it pays off-chain through Stripe (MPP). The job has no vault, no funding step, no challenge window, dispute or claim; it is always proof-gated by `policy` (snapshotted like `create_job`). Both parties need a fresh, clear screening record. The agent accepts it while Open.

CreateJobCall.description: Flow step 3a: the institution opens a job for an active registered agent and creates its empty vault. With the optional `policy` account the job is proof-gated and snapshots the policy's commitment, daily ceiling and version. Funds move in `fund_job`.

EscalateMissingProofCall.description: The agent's recourse when a policy job's release cannot settle: `proof_timeout_secs` after `challenge_end` (or after a lapsed dispute closed) with no bound proof, a temporary refusal, a proof evaluated on another UTC day or a proof for another net amount or mint, it opens a dispute without bond.

ExecuteResolutionCall.description: Permissionless: pays out a `Resolved` dispute. The agent-side amount goes through the same payee resolution and proof gate as `finalize_payment` (no keeper fee); the bond is slashed to the agent side (FavorAgent) or returned to the institution. Closes the vaults.

FinalizeFiatPaymentCall.description: Fiat rail (ADR 0024), permissionless: records a delivered fiat job as paid once the verifier's `verify_mpp_payment_proof` bound a compliant `ReleaseProof` (payee = agent wallet, net = full `amount`, fresh daily counter). CPIs `record_release`, writes reputation and a `Verified` `ValidationRecord`, moves the job to `Released`. No funds move and no keeper fee is paid.

FinalizePaymentCall.description: Flow steps 6-8, permissionless crank. After `challenge_end` with no dispute: - no policy: pay the payee (claim buyer if sold, else agent wallet) `amount - keeper fee`; - policy: read `ReleaseProof` ["release_proof", job] owned by square_verifier. Missing -> `ProofRequired` (escrow waits). `Compliant` with matching payee / net / mint / daily counter -> pay the payee, CPI `record_release`, `ReleaseVerified`. `Refused` -> refund the net to the institution, `ReleaseRefused` with the reason code.  The keeper fee is paid in every branch. Reputation goes to the agent record (not the buyer); a `ValidationRecord` is written; the vault is closed and its rent returned to `job.rent_payer`.

FundJobCall.description: Flow step 3b: locks `amount` in the vault. Both parties need a fresh, clear screening record. CCTP (DRAFT M6, BC-36): runs in the same tx after the CCTP `receive_message` that mints USDC to the institution's token account; no separate instruction is planned.

InitConfigCall.description: Creates the singleton config. Only the program upgrade authority (Squads vault) can call it. `settlement_mint` is the only job mint (USDC); `linked` pins the registry / policy / verifier program IDs used for account-read owner checks.

LapseDisputeCall.description: Permissionless at or after `dispute.deadline` without a decision. Returns the bond and drops the dispute: the job goes back to `Delivered` and settles through `finalize_payment`.

ListClaimCall.description: The agent lists its receivable on a delivered job below face value.

RaiseDisputeCall.description: The institution disputes a delivery inside the challenge window with a bond `>= max(amount * min_bond_bps / 10_000, min_bond_absolute)`. One dispute per job.

ResolveDisputeCall.description: One arbitrator vote. The first vote sets the pending resolution, later votes must match it; reaching the threshold moves the job to `Resolved` (`DisputeDecided`). No funds move here.

SubmitWorkCall.description: Flow step 4: delivery; the challenge window opens (`challenge_end = now + challenge_period`).

SyncAgentWalletCall.description: The agent record owner re-points an unsettled job to the record's current wallet (after a wallet rotation with registry `update_agent`). A sold receivable keeps paying the buyer.

UpdateArbitratorsCall.description: Replaces the arbitrator set (N <= 7, 2 <= M <= N) and bumps `arbitrator_set_version`. An active dispute keeps its deadline; its next vote restarts the tally with the new set.

UpdateParamsCall.description: Updates challenge bounds, bond, keeper fee, proof and dispute timeouts and the Travel Rule threshold.
